Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Emil Frey Digital AG gehört zur Emil Frey Gruppe und ist eine Full Service Kommunikations-Dienstleisterin für die Automobilbranche sowie verantwortlich für die Digitalisierung innerhalb der Emil Frey Gruppe. descriptionByLocale.it:
Cosa dovresti sapere su di noi Il gruppo Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri principali dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è l'importazione di marchi automobilistici, la gestione di officine, la logistica di pezzi di ricambio e accessori e la fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey Digital AG fa parte del gruppo Emil Frey ed è un fornitore di servizi di comunicazione completo per l'industria automobilistica ed è responsabile della digitalizzazione all'interno del gruppo Emil Frey. Per rafforzare il nostro team Key Account cerchiamo immediatamente o su appuntamento un consulente clienti/consulente clienti/key account a Zurigo. I tuoi compiti
• Realizzerai progetti innovativi digitali, analogici e crossmediali per i marchi leader del Gruppo Emil Frey - dalla prima idea fino alla fase di go-live di successo. Definisci attivamente la comunicazione del marchio e contribuisci in modo significativo al successo dei nostri marchi.
• Sei la persona di contatto per i nostri clienti e li consigli in modo olistico sui servizi digitali e analogici. Sviluppi concetti creativi e soluzioni su misura che aumentano in modo sostenibile il successo dei nostri clienti
• Sei responsabile del budget, dei tempi, della qualità e delle risorse e garantisci che tutti i progetti siano gestiti in modo strutturato ed efficiente
• Accompagni i nostri clienti con passione e sfrutti l'opportunità per contribuire con le tue idee e modellare attivamente i processi interni
• Stabilisci una gestione del miglioramento continuo e assicuri che le ottimizzazioni dei processi siano regolarmente controllate e adattate. In questo modo raccogli feedback, migliori le misure e promuovi una cultura del miglioramento continuo Il tuo profilo
• Hai completato una laurea o una formazione professionale nel campo del marketing digitale, della comunicazione o in un campo correlato
• Hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale nel settore del marketing, idealmente in un ambiente di agenzia
• Dimostri prestazioni eccellenti sia in squadra che in modo indipendente, sei resiliente e pronto ad assumerti responsabilità. I tuoi risultati sono il biglietto da visita del tuo lavoro ed espressione dei tuoi elevati standard di qualità
• Hai fiducia nella consulenza ai clienti e nell'acquisizione di progetti e puoi presentare le tue idee e concetti in modo convincente
• La conoscenza del francese e dell'italiano è un vantaggio
• Sei multitasking, la definizione delle priorità e il coordinamento di diverse parti interessate sono tra i tuoi punti di forza
• Hai esperienza con Microsoft Office, Jira & Confluence Cosa ti offriamo Con noi troverai una nuova sfida con compiti entusiasmanti e molto altro ancora:
• Numerosi sconti (auto nuove e usate, lavori di assistenza e pezzi di ricambio ricambi, assicurazione veicolo e assicurazione sanitaria, carte carburante, hotel e molto altro)

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not just a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey Digital AG is part of the Emil Frey Group and is a full-service communication service provider for the automotive industry, as well as responsible for digitalization within the Emil Frey Group. To strengthen our key account team, we are looking for a key account manager in Zurich for immediate start or after agreement a key account manager / key account manager / key account manager. Your tasks
• You will execute innovative digital, analog and cross-media projects for leading brands of the Emil Frey Group - from the first idea to the successful go-live phase. In this way, you shape the brand communication and contribute significantly to the success of our brands.
• You are the point of contact for our customers and advise them comprehensively on digital and analog services. You develop creative concepts and tailored solutions that increase the long-term success of our customers.
• You are responsible for budget, deadline, quality and resources and ensure that all projects are structured and efficiently executed.
• You accompany our customers with passion and use the opportunity to present your ideas and contribute actively to the development of internal processes.
• You establish a continuous improvement management and ensure that process optimizations are regularly checked and adapted. In this way, you collect feedback, improve measures and promote a culture of continuous improvement. Your profile
• You have a degree in digital marketing, communication or a related field
• You have at least 5 years of work experience in the marketing field, preferably in the agency sector
• Show high performance both in team and alone, be resilient and willing to take responsibility. Your results are the business card of your work and the expression of your high quality standards
• You are sure in customer consulting and project acquisition and can present your ideas and concepts convincingly
• French and Italian language skills are an advantage
• You are able to multitasking, prioritization and coordination of various stakeholders
• You have experience with Microsoft Office, Jira & Confluence. What we offer You will find with us a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• Your own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation. How to contact us We look forward to your complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms male, female and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to tap into our full potential.
• You will execute innovative digital, analog and cross-media projects for leading brands of the Emil Frey Group - from the first idea to the successful go-live phase. In this way, you shape the brand communication and contribute significantly to the success of our brands.
• You are the point of contact for our customers and advise them comprehensively on digital and analog services. You develop creative concepts and tailored solutions that increase the long-term success of our customers.
• You are responsible for budget, deadline, quality and resources and ensure that all projects are structured and efficiently executed.
• You accompany our customers with passion and use the opportunity to present your ideas and contribute actively to the development of internal processes.
• You establish a continuous improvement management and ensure that process optimizations are regularly checked and adapted. In this way, you collect feedback, improve measures and promote a culture of continuous improvement
• You have a degree in digital marketing, communication or a related field
• You have at least 5 years of work experience in the marketing field, preferably in the agency sector
• Show high performance both in team and alone, be resilient and willing to take responsibility. Your results are the business card of your work and the expression of your high quality standards
• You are sure in customer consulting and project acquisition and can present your ideas and concepts convincingly
• French and Italian language skills are an advantage
• You are able to multitasking, prioritization and coordination of various stakeholders
• You have experience with Microsoft Office, Jira & Confluence.

De cette manière, vous façonnez la communication de marque et contribuez de manière significative au succès de nos marques.
